Since both added terms are squares, equality at the minimum requires 3 unit products summing to 0, exactly a rotated equilateral triple, automatically T=Q=0. The upper bound follows |S|<=3, |T|<=3, |Q|<=3 and equality requires all products equal. The six-phase torus is connected, so intermediate values attained; the specified 4-torus equivalence leaves 2 minimizing orbits. In mu_q, products realize an equilateral triple iff 3 divides q, with 2q choices of product triples each with q^3 factorizations; maximum q^4. Since P^4 is supported inside [-4,4]^3, sampled grids Ni>=9 avoid Fourier aliasing. No smaller-grid claim is inferred.
